classification: REVIEWER AUTHORIZED SCIENTIFIC REPAIR AND PREFLIGHT SPECIFICATION
authorization: V2E prompt and operator-relayed exact V2D metrics with C1-C9 clarifications
changes: N-SIGN swaps within negative, disabled and positive effective source signs; contact counts and signed weights stay on their original source edges. Each stratum requests its original edge count in completed swaps, with autapses frozen.

Stochastic C-SIMPLE uses independent stream 37 and the identical LIF recurrence, kappa and p. LC4/LPLC2 fractions use their combined measured direct DNp01 contact count as denominator, pooled sides. All evaluated gain values and fit mismatches are retained.

C-SIMPLE bounded search evaluates 0 and 64 then 32 bisections. Lowest gain among closest evaluated fractions wins. At most one standard trial of mismatch is allowed. Failure at a selected point stops the run; no refit or revised bound.

C-NOISE-DEC matches expected group rates; finite observations use the declared max(5%, three Poisson standard errors) reporting bound. Lesions match zero named-neuron activity, not a behavioral outcome. C-TIMER retains its exact 30 ms lead target.

The existing onset convention is preserved: control-boundary rising edges strictly after strike start and strictly before impact. DNp01 spike counts for H1c include neural spike boundaries after strike start and before impact; a spike at impact is excluded.

H2 uses the previously decoded command applied during each control interval for movement, turn and segmentation. Positive turn means decoded left-group rate exceeds right-group rate. Pairs never cross trial boundaries.
H0 censored critical values tie at the top for ranking. A 0.11 sentinel is only a computational rank encoding; effects involving a censored real or null median are reported as not point identifiable.
Fresh confirmatory null seeds and a separate predeclared game scramble seed exclude all pilot seeds. H0 is pilot-motivated and no null H0 sweep is run before freeze.
